evidence.reason: After edit contains 'rereturn reminders.evaluate(...)', which is invalid syntax and prevents the module from compiling.
Default multiplier changed from configuration.rate to 0, so callers omitting multiplier now compute a different delay (priorities[0] becomes 0).
evaluate value-references reminderDelay; the changed default propagates to evaluate and thus to scheduledDelay and tests.
Test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0; with the syntax error and changed default, this assertion cannot be satisfied.

result.userExplanation: 左侧改动引入了语法错误，右侧改动改变了 reminderDelay 的默认乘数，二者合并后会导致编译失败并破坏依赖该默认值的调用方行为。
result.suggestedAction: 请将 src/scheduling.ts 中 scheduledDelay 的 'rereturn' 改回 'return'，并将 src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 的默认参数 multiplier 恢复为 configuration.rate。
